info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Actions Review Submission API
info.description: The Corporate Actions Review Submission API enables financial institutions to submit reviews related to corporate actions. This API is essential for ensuring compliance and enhancing transparency in corporate governance. Users, typically market analysts or compliance officers, can leverage it to submit, track, and manage reviews efficiently. By facilitating this process, the API enhances the review workflow and ensures timely responses to corporate events, thereby supporting informed decision-making in the financial landscape.
